title: Only Sweet! Only Sweet!
summary: Shaked wants to eat only sweets and nothing else! When Dad serves soup with carrots and lettuce, the candy cupboard bursts open, a jelly bear hops out and invites her to a land made entirely of candy. She eats, bounces and spins, until a sugar storm melts houses and bridges. But what happens when the storm is over and her heart wants something warm? A silly, wild rhyming story with a refrain that is fun to shout, inspired by Dr. Seuss's way of writing.
pages:
Dad served soup, some lettuce, an orange carrot too,
And Shaked said, "No way! That just won't do!"
"Only sweet! Only sweet! And nothing else to eat!"
The cupboard swung open: CRRREAK! What a sound!
Out hopped a jelly: "Surprise! I'm no bug on the ground!"

"I'm Gummy, a jelly, I wobble like jam,
Where I live there's endless candy – that's the way I am!
Come on, the cake has opened a door – jump through, you'll see!"
"Only sweet! Only sweet! And nothing else to eat!"

Wow! A chocolate river, cake houses, whipped cream on a tree,
Candy, candy, candy, as far as the eye can see!
Shaked drank a whole river – GLUG, GLUG!
And ate a whole roof: CHOMP, CHOMP, CHUG!
"Only sweet! Only sweet! And nothing else to eat!"

Bite-bite-bite! Lick-lick-lick!
Marshmallow puffs, ice cream, chocolate – tick-tick-tick!
"Only sweet! Only sweet! And nothing else to eat!"
Then her tummy spoke up, in a voice small and thin: "Burp."

Shaked bounced like a spring and zoomed like a jet,
And spun like an omelet on a pepper, the dizziest yet!
A huge pink cloud rose, and suddenly all turned cold,
And Gummy yelled, "Sugar storm! Everyone, hold!"

The storm arrived! Whipped-cream thunder: BOOM-BOOM-BOOM!
A rain of candies, gummy hail, and lightning: ZOOM!
Houses dripped, a bridge stretched out like stretchy cheese,
And Shaked laughed on a donut... her last laugh, if you please.

Quiet. The storm died down, and the colors were gone.
Shaked sat in caramel, all alone.
A tear rolled down. She whispered, "I want warm soup, I do,
And I want Dad to be there too."

Gummy sighed and sat down, and whispered a secret just so:
"I dream of a pickle. Just one, and no more, you know!"
And suddenly, beyond the hills, a ribbon of steam rose high,
And the smell of home called to all friends nearby.

Shaked climbed up the steam as if it were a ladder,
Then Gummy, the Duke, and a cookie – everyone came after!
Step-step-step, hurry-hurry, a warm and lovely smell,
And there was the cake door, open... so close, so close, so close as well!

Shaked came out sticky, with candies in each ear,
And Dad opened his arms. No words. Just eyes, warm and clear.
And the soup? Still warm, because Dad had waited there.
And Shaked whispered, "Could I... have soup?" in a voice as small as air.

Shaked ate warm soup, and carrots, and bread with cheese,
And it all tasted yummy, like the very first time, if you please.
"Only sweet?" Dad smiled, and gave her one more carrot to eat.
"No!" laughed Shaked. "A bit of it all! A bit of everything else, not only sweet!"

And at the end one little candy was waiting there,
And Shaked licked it slowly, like a present, with care.
"Another one?" asked Dad, and raised an eyebrow above.
"No!" laughed Shaked. "More carrots, more lettuce – that's love!"
